en: First Chapter The Elder’s Verses, Book One, Chapter One, Verse Five: The Single Recitation Section, First Chapter.
The Verses of the Elder Dabba:
“He who was difficult to tame has been tamed by self-mastery;
Dabba is peaceful, contented, and has crossed beyond doubt.”
"Vijitāvī, free from fear, Dabba has indeed attained final nibbāna, established in himself.
Thus indeed did the venerable elder Dabba speak this verse.
